Typify.dev (https://typify.dev) | AI Application Engineer + Product Engineer | San Francisco (hybrid / remote available) | VISA | $80-120K USD (Negotiable) | galen@typify.dev

We're Typify, an education company for engineers that teaches functional programming and system design before pairing them with projects & job prospects. We're hiring for two roles: Both mid-senior, Angular + NestJS + Postgres.

AI Application Engineer. Forward-deployed, ship LLM features close to real users, iterate on real usage, design guardrails and evals. RAG, agents, prompt and context engineering, tool orchestration. Bonus: conversational/voice AI, fine-tuning, healthcare AI, MCP.

Product Engineer. Own features end to end, scope, build, ship, measure, iterate. Strong product sense, UX obsession for a sensitive health product. Bonus: consumer or health product experience, early-stage startup time.

To apply: goto https://typify.dev/jobs/view/189 or https://typify.dev/jobs/view/188. Just need your github and resume.

More on how we think: github.com/TypifyDev, r/haskell (u/_lazyLambda), @SimpleHaskell on YouTube.
